SEARCH
Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.proxy

Interface EzMessenger

All Superinterfaces:
ServerConnection
public interface EzMessenger extends ServerConnection
High-level, platform-agnostic messaging API for cross-server packet exchange.

EzMessenger extends ServerConnection with handler registration and convenience overloads that accept raw EzPackets (automatically wrapped in a ServerMessage on the default channel).

Platform modules (Velocity, BungeeCord, …) provide implementations by implementing the two ServerConnection primitives: ServerConnection.send(String, ServerMessage) and ServerConnection.broadcast(ServerMessage).

Typical usage: 


 // Register a handler
 messenger.registerHandler(BalanceResponsePacket.class, (packet, ctx) ->
     logger.info("Balance for " + packet.getPlayerId() + ": " + packet.getBalance()));

 // Send using the convenience overload (uses default channel)
 messenger.send("survival", new BalanceRequestPacket(playerName, UUID.randomUUID().toString()));

 // Or send with an explicit channel
 messenger.send("survival", ServerMessage.of(packet, new EzChannel("myplugin:data")));

    • bridgeEvent

      default <T extends EzPacket, E extends ProxyPacketEvent> void bridgeEvent(Class<T> packetType, BiFunction<T,EzContext,E> factory, ProxyEventManager manager)
      Register a handler that converts an incoming packet into a ProxyPacketEvent and fires it through the given ProxyEventManager.

      This is the recommended way to integrate the packet listener system with an existing messenger. The factory receives the deserialized packet and its EzContext and must return a concrete ProxyPacketEvent subtype; the manager then dispatches the event to all PacketListener-annotated handlers registered on it.

      Example: 

      
 messenger.bridgeEvent(
     PlayerLoginPacket.class,
     PlayerLoginPacketEvent::new,   // (packet, ctx) -> new PlayerLoginPacketEvent(ctx, packet)
     eventManager);
      Type Parameters:
      T - the concrete packet type
      E - the concrete event type
      Parameters:
      packetType - the packet class to intercept
      factory - converts a packet and its context into the event object
      manager - the event manager to fire the constructed event through
